layers.authority: Cliffs of Moher Experience (visitor attraction on the Clare coast)
layers.process: Admission is charged and a booking buys a 2-hour visit from the entry time. Online rates listed for 2027: adult EUR 14 at peak (about A$22.25), EUR 9 off-peak (A$14.30), EUR 7 late evening in summer (A$11.12); family EUR 28 peak. Gate rates without booking: adult EUR 15 in 2026 and EUR 16 in 2027 (about A$25.42, RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293). Children under 12 are free with a parent or guardian (up to 4). Coach groups of 10 or more book through the groups department.

laws.rule: Cliffs of Moher: dogs must stay on leads and are not allowed in the visitor centre unless they are registered guide or support dogs.
